research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01. All seven frozen occupations retained, supplemented by RAHC management title/nonprofit control, Standby Reserve distinction, broader charity affiliation, training fellowship and event work. No full-time totals derived from military rank or senior titles.

Follow-up: service record distinguishing regular, reserve and continuous full-time duty, enlistment/discharge/return dates and leave. Reconcile claimed 13 years with year-only 1990–2001 and 2005–2008; do not sum coarse intervals or 26 years of formal association.

Follow-up: RAHC first manager contract and termination, Vinnies historical 2010–11 annual/employment records, presidential adviser contracting and whether concurrent with RAHC; charity operational/volunteer history through 2022. Government funding not government control.

Follow-up: resolve 2011 versus January 2012 political-staff start, precise Crossin/Snowdon office transitions and gaps; identify tourism/event contracting and any other paid work. January 2010–January 2011 CEO and October 2008–April 2010 RAHC dates appeared in a people-data broker result but were not adopted without primary corroboration.

Searched own/official/Defence biographies, historical first speech, employer anniversary post, government RAHC evaluation, Vinnies annual-report searches, public professional profile, fellowship alumni and event history. No individual substantive hours established. Direct APH first speech restricted and LinkedIn (999) Unknown Status Code; public indexed evidence used without access bypass. Charity/profile span remains affiliation, not proven salary.
No new roster or party snapshot applied. Later media allegations unrelated to employment-history task excluded. Missing evidence is not zero; blocked record requires follow-up across remaining gaps.

Follow-up2026-10-02: public professional index independently establishes RAHC managerOctober2008–April2010 and charity volunteer operations roleJuly2002–June2022. Earlier broker-only RAHC lead now primary-corroborated; broker-only VinniesJanuary2010–January2011 remains unadopted.

Targeted employer/annual-report and Army full-time searches returned later charity supporter records or general recruiting commentary, not individual historic hours. Another former soldier memoir describes own regular service and work with Gosling; its service conditions cannot be attributed to Gosling. Civilian overlap and regular/reserve dates remain open. Next leads: originalRAHC2008–10staff reports, Vinnies2010–11appointment record, Defence individual service-category chronology.

Follow-up 2026-10-04: the public index for Gosling's own professional profile now directly exposes the Vinnies entry as Chief Executive Officer, St Vincent de Paul Society (NT) Inc,2010–2011. This corroborates the frozen year range and resolves the legal organisation name, but not exact boundaries, hours or overlap with RAHC and presidential advisory work. Targeted Vinnies annual-report searches did not recover a contemporaneous appointment notice.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Targeted RAHC2009 staff/manager, Vinnies2010/2011 appointment and individual military-full-time searches did not recover primary employment boundaries or hours. The 1July2024 debate search snippet juxtaposes Gosling with a not-full-time-soldier statement; full debate speaker attribution shows that statement belongs to Bob Katter (OpenAustralia debate2024-07-01.92.2 lines385–420), so no workload fact added to Gosling. Another serviceman’s regular-duty memoir and current recruiting totals cannot establish his service category. The public professional broker’s January2010–January2011 Vinnies range remains unadopted without primary confirmation. Accessible biographies still corroborate existing broad chronology. Advance rather than repeat exhausted searches; next productive leads original employer appointment/separation notices and individual Defence category records.

Follow-up2026-10-05: identity-checked13September2017 House speech supplies explicit own full-time Army work in a Reserve unit, separately from reservist membership. Recorded undated full-time component, not automatic full-time status for either frozen service interval or additional summed years. Specific unit/dates/leave remain unknown. Original linked Hansard403Forbidden; accessible transcript attributes this statement to Gosling, unlike previous Katter false-positive. RAHC/Vinnies searches added no exact appointment or workload evidence. Continue targeted service-category chronology and original employer notices; null totals retained.
